exercises.instructionUz: Qiyoslash — sifat / qiyosiy daraja / orttirma daraja
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI ASOSIY JADVAL:

 ┌───────────────┬───────────┬────────────────┬──────────────────┐
 │               │ ADJECTIVE │  COMPARATIVE   │   SUPERLATIVE    │
 │               │  (sifat)  │   (qiyosiy)    │    (orttirma)    │
 ├───────────────┼───────────┼────────────────┼──────────────────┤
 │ ONE-SYLLABLE  │  cheap    │ cheapER (than) │ THE cheapEST     │
 │  adjectives   │  large    │ largER (than)  │ THE largEST      │
 │ (bir bo'g'inli)│  big      │ bigGER (than)  │ THE bigGEST      │
 ├───────────────┼───────────┼────────────────┼──────────────────┤
 │ -Y adjectives │  noisy    │ noisIER (than) │ THE noisIEST     │
 ├───────────────┼───────────┼────────────────┼──────────────────┤
 │ TWO OR MORE   │ expensive │ MORE expensive │ THE MOST         │
 │  SYLLABLES    │           │      (than)    │      expensive   │
 ├───────────────┼───────────┼────────────────┼──────────────────┤
 │               │  good     │ better (than)  │ THE best         │
 │  IRREGULAR    │  bad      │ worse  (than)  │ THE worst        │
 │  adjectives   │ much/many │ more   (than)  │ THE most         │
 │ (noto'g'ri)   │  little   │ less   (than)  │ THE least        │
 └───────────────┴───────────┴────────────────┴──────────────────┘


DIQQAT — JADVALDAGI IKKI QAVSNING MA'NOSI:

  QIYOSIY ustunida '(than)' —
     qiyosiy daraja odatda THAN bilan keladi.

  ORTTIRMA ustunida 'the' QALIN yozilgan —
     orttirma daraja DOIM 'THE' bilan keladi.


BU JADVAL Coursebook 84-BETDAGI JADVALNING
AYNAN O'ZI — kitob bir qoidani IKKI KITOBDA
ham beradi. Grammar Book qo'shimcha tafsilotlar
('of/in', bo'g'inlar soni, urg'u) qo'shadi.

points.en: one-syllable adjectives: cheap → cheaper (than) → the cheapest
points.uz: bir bo'g'inli sifatlar: arzon → arzonroq → eng arzon
points.noteUz: -ER / THE -EST qo'shiladi.

points.en: large → larger (than) → the largest
points.noteUz: '-e' bilan tugagan → faqat -R va -ST.

points.en: big → bigger (than) → the biggest
points.noteUz: Oxirgi undosh IKKILANADI.

points.en: -y adjectives: noisy → noisier (than) → the noisiest
points.uz: -y bilan tugagan sifatlar: shovqinli → shovqinliroq → eng shovqinli
points.noteUz: '-y' tushadi, -IER / THE -IEST qo'shiladi.

points.en: adjectives with two or more syllables: expensive → more expensive (than) → the most expensive
points.uz: ikki yoki undan ko'p bo'g'inli sifatlar: qimmat → qimmatroq → eng qimmat
points.noteUz:
Sifatning O'ZI o'zgarmaydi;
oldiga MORE / THE MOST qo'shiladi.

points.en: irregular: good → better (than) → the best
points.noteUz: YODLASH kerak. 'gooder' XATO.

points.en: irregular: bad → worse (than) → the worst
points.noteUz: YODLASH kerak. 'badder' XATO.

points.en: irregular: much / many → more (than) → the most
points.noteUz:
'much' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot bilan (much water),
'many' — SANALADIGAN ot bilan (many books).
Qiyosiy shakli ikkalasi uchun bir xil: MORE.

points.en: irregular: little → less (than) → the least
points.noteUz: 'much/many' ning AKSI.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI 'FORM' QUTISI — BESh QOIDA:


1) BIR BO'G'INLI sifatlar '-(e)r' / '-(e)st'
   qo'shadi.

     large  -  largER (than)  -  THE largEST (of/in)
     cheap  -  cheapER (than) -  THE cheapEST (of/in)

   DIQQAT — '(e)' QAVSNING MA'NOSI:
     Sifat allaqachon '-e' bilan tugasa,
     yana bitta 'e' QO'ShILMAYDI:
        large → largER ('largeer' XATO)
        nice  → nicER
        safe  → safER
     '-e' bilan tugamasa, to'liq '-er' qo'shiladi:
        cheap → cheapER
        old   → oldER


2) BIR BO'G'INLI sifatlar IKKI UNDOSh ORASIDA
   BITTA URG'ULI UNLI bilan tugasa —
   oxirgi undosh IKKILANADI va '-er'/'-est'
   qo'shiladi.

     big  -  bigGER (than)  -  THE bigGEST (of/in)

   QOIDANI QANDAY TEKShIRISh — UCh ShART:
     • bir bo'g'inli
     • oxiri: UNDOSh + UNLI + UNDOSh
     • unli URG'ULI

     b-i-g   →  b (undosh) + i (unli) + g (undosh) ✓
     h-o-t   →  h + o + t  ✓  → hotTER
     f-a-t   →  f + a + t  ✓  → fatTER
     t-h-i-n →  th + i + n ✓  → thinNER
     s-a-d   →  s + a + d  ✓  → sadDER

   ISTISNOLAR (ikkilanmaydi):
     • ikki unli bo'lsa:  cheap (ea) → cheapER
     • ikki undosh bo'lsa: fast (st) → fastER
     • 'w', 'x', 'y' bilan tugasa:
        new  → newER   (newwer XATO)
        slow → slowER


3) IKKI BO'G'INLI sifatlar UNDOSh + '-Y' bilan
   tugasa — '-y' tushadi va '-ier'/'-iest'
   qo'shiladi.

     heavy  -  heavIER (than)  -  THE heavIEST (of/in)

   DIQQAT — 'UNDOSh + Y' ShARTI:
     heavy  → heav + y   → 'v' undosh ✓ → heavIER
     noisy  → nois + y   → 's' undosh ✓ → noisIER
     easy   → eas + y    → 's' undosh ✓ → easIER
     happy  → happ + y   → 'p' undosh ✓ → happIER
     busy   → bus + y    → 's' undosh ✓ → busIER
     pretty → prett + y  → 't' undosh ✓ → prettIER

     Agar '-y' dan oldin UNLI bo'lsa —
     '-y' TUShMAYDI:
        grey → greyER (greier XATO)


4) IKKI VA UNDAN KO'P BO'G'INLI sifatlar
   'MORE' / 'MOST' oladi.

     careful  -  MORE careful (than)
              -  THE MOST careful (of/in)

   Boshqa misollar:
     expensive   → more expensive
     beautiful   → more beautiful
     interesting → more interesting
     comfortable → more comfortable


5) NOTO'G'RI sifatlarning O'Z shakllari bor
   (yuqoridagi jadvalga qarang).

     good/bad/much/many/little


DIQQAT — 3 va 4-QOIDA CHALKAShIShI MUMKIN:
  'heavy' ham IKKI BO'G'INLI, 'careful' ham.
  FARQI:
     heavy   — '-y' bilan tugaydi → -IER
     careful — '-y' bilan tugaMAYDI → MORE
  Ya'ni 3-qoida 4-qoidadan KUCHLIROQ:
  ikki bo'g'inli sifat '-y' bilan tugasa,
  MORE emas, -IER oladi.

points.en: One-syllable adjectives add -(e)r/-(e)st to form their comparative and superlative forms.
points.uz: Bir bo'g'inli sifatlar qiyosiy va orttirma darajasini yasash uchun -(e)r/-(e)st qo'shadi.
points.noteUz:
'(e)' qavsi shuni bildiradi:
sifat allaqachon '-e' bilan tugasa,
yana 'e' qo'shilmaydi.

points.en: large - larger (than) - the largest (of/in), cheap - cheaper (than) - the cheapest (of/in)
points.uz: katta - kattaroq - eng katta, arzon - arzonroq - eng arzon
points.noteUz:
'large' → 'largeer' EMAS, 'largER'.
Orttirma daraja 'OF' yoki 'IN' bilan keladi.

points.en: One-syllable adjectives ending in one stressed vowel between two consonants, double the last consonant and add -er/-est.
points.uz: Ikki undosh orasida bitta urg'uli unli bilan tugagan bir bo'g'inli sifatlar oxirgi undoshni ikkilantiradi va -er/-est qo'shadi.
points.noteUz:
UCH SHART: bir bo'g'in +
undosh-unli-undosh + urg'uli unli.

points.en: big - bigger (than) - the biggest (of/in)
points.noteUz:
b + i + g → 'g' IKKILANADI.
Shunday: hot→hotter, fat→fatter, thin→thinner,
sad→sadder.

points.en: Two-syllable adjectives ending in a consonant + -y, drop -y and add -ier/-iest.
points.uz: Undosh + '-y' bilan tugagan ikki bo'g'inli sifatlar '-y' ni tushiradi va '-ier/-iest' qo'shadi.
points.noteUz:
DIQQAT: '-y' dan OLDIN UNDOSH bo'lishi shart.
Unli bo'lsa (grey) '-y' tushmaydi.

points.en: heavy - heavier (than) - the heaviest (of/in)
points.noteUz:
heav + y → heavIER.
Shunday: noisy→noisier, easy→easier,
happy→happier, busy→busier.

points.en: Adjectives of two or more syllables take more/most.
points.uz: Ikki va undan ko'p bo'g'inli sifatlar more/most oladi.
points.noteUz: Sifatning O'ZI o'zgarmaydi.

points.en: careful - more careful (than) - the most careful (of/in)
points.noteUz:
DIQQAT: 'careful' ikki bo'g'inli, lekin
'-y' bilan tugamaydi → MORE oladi.
'heavy' bilan SOLISHTIRING.

points.en: Irregular adjectives have their own individual comparative and superlative forms.
points.uz: Noto'g'ri sifatlarning o'ziga xos qiyosiy va orttirma shakllari bor.
points.noteUz:
good/bad/much/many/little —
yuqoridagi jadvalda.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI 'NOTE' QUTISI — IKKI ESLATMA:


1) Qiyoslashni ko'pincha 'THAN' bilan qilamiz.

     The city is noisier THAN the country.
     An elephant is heavier THAN a mouse.
     Trains are more expensive THAN buses.

   DIQQAT: 'than' o'zbekchada '... dan' ga
   to'g'ri keladi:
     'noisier THAN the country'
     = 'qishloqDAN shovqinliroq'


2) Orttirma daraja oldidan 'THE' qo'yamiz.

     THE cheapest hotel
     THE most expensive restaurant
     THE best

   Bu — ENG KO'P UNUTILADIGAN QOIDA.
   'He is tallest boy' XATO.
   'He is THE tallest boy' TO'G'RI.

   SABABI: orttirma daraja narsani ANIQ
   ko'rsatadi (bittasi, yagona) — shuning uchun
   aniq artikl 'the' kerak.


ESLAB QOLISh UChUN:
     QIYOSIY   →  THAN bilan
     ORTTIRMA  →  THE bilan (va OF/IN bilan)

points.en: We often make comparisons using than.
points.noteUz:
'than' = o'zbekchadagi '... dan'.
Faqat QIYOSIY daraja bilan.

points.en: We use the before the superlative form.
points.noteUz:
ENG KO'P UNUTILADIGAN QOIDA.
'the cheapest', 'the best', 'the most expensive'.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI 'USE' QUTISI — TO'RT QOIDA:


1) QIYOSIY DARAJA — IKKI odam, narsa, joyni
   solishtiradi. Odatda 'THAN' bilan.

     'The city is NOISIER THAN the country.'
     (Shahar qishloqdan shovqinliroq.)


2) ORTTIRMA DARAJA — bitta odam yoki narsani
   O'ZI MANSUB BO'LGAN BUTUN GURUH bilan
   solishtiradi.
   'THE ... OF' yoki 'THE ... IN' bilan.

     'The giraffe is THE TALLEST animal OF all.'
     (Jirafa hamma hayvonlardan eng balandi.)

   DIQQAT — 'OF' va 'IN' FARQI:
     OF + guruh:
        the tallest OF all
        the best OF the three
        the oldest OF my friends
     IN + joy:
        the tallest building IN the USA
        the cheapest hotel IN town
        the largest desert IN the world


3) (NOT) AS + sifat + AS — ikki odam, joy yoki
   narsa O'XShASh yoki O'XShASh EMASligini
   aytadi.

     'My brother is AS TALL AS my father.'
     (Akam otam chalik baland bo'yli.)

   IKKI XIL MA'NO:
     AS ... AS      = TENG
        'as tall as' = bir xil bo'yda
     NOT AS ... AS  = KAMROQ
        'not as tall as' = undan pastroq

   DIQQAT: 'as' va 'as' orasiga sifatning
   ODDIY shakli qo'yiladi.
     'as taller as' XATO
     'as tall as' TO'G'RI


4) MUCH + QIYOSIY daraja.

     'An elephant is MUCH HEAVIER than a mouse.'
     (Fil sichqondan ancha og'irroq.)

   'much' farqni KUChAYTIRADI.
   DIQQAT: faqat QIYOSIY daraja bilan.
     'much heavy' XATO
     'much heavier' TO'G'RI


UMUMIY XULOSA — QAYSI QOLIP QAChON:

  IKKI narsa, farq bor      →  -ER/MORE ... THAN
  IKKI narsa, farq KATTA    →  MUCH -ER/MORE ... THAN
  IKKI narsa, TENG          →  AS ... AS
  IKKI narsa, teng EMAS     →  NOT AS ... AS
  BUTUN GURUHdan eng yuqori →  THE -EST/MOST ... OF/IN

points.en: We use the comparative form to compare two people, things, places, etc. We usually use than with comparative adjectives.
points.uz: Qiyosiy darajani ikki odam, narsa, joyni solishtirish uchun ishlatamiz. Odatda 'than' bilan.
points.noteUz: IKKITA narsa → QIYOSIY daraja.

points.en: The city is noisier than the country.
points.noteUz:
'noisy' → '-y' tushadi → 'noisIER'.
'the country' bu yerda 'qishloq, shahardan
tashqari joy' ma'nosida ('mamlakat' emas).

points.en: We use the superlative form to compare a person or thing with the whole group they belong to. We use the ... of/in with superlative adjectives.
points.uz: Orttirma darajani bitta odam yoki narsani o'zi mansub bo'lgan butun guruh bilan solishtirish uchun ishlatamiz. 'the ... of/in' bilan.
points.noteUz:
OF + guruh, IN + joy.
DOIM 'THE' bilan.

points.en: The giraffe is the tallest animal of all.
points.noteUz:
'the tallest ... OF all' — guruh bilan OF.
'a giraffe' = jirafa.

points.en: We use (not) as + adjective + as to say that two people, places or things are/are not similar.
points.uz: Ikki odam, joy yoki narsa o'xshash yoki o'xshash emasligini aytish uchun '(not) as + sifat + as' ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz:
'as' va 'as' orasiga sifatning ODDIY shakli.
'as taller as' XATO.

points.en: My brother is as tall as my father.
points.noteUz:
TENGLIK: ikkalasi bir xil bo'yda.
Inkor bo'lsa ('isn't as tall as') —
akasi PASTROQ degani.

points.en: We use much + comparative form.
points.noteUz:
Farqni KUCHAYTIRADI.
Faqat QIYOSIY daraja bilan.

points.en: An elephant is much heavier than a mouse.
points.noteUz:
'heavy' → 'heavIER'.
'a mouse' = sichqon (ko'pligi: MICE).

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI:

  'very', 'quite' yoki 'too' kabi so'zlarni
  biror narsa yoki odam QANChALIK sovuq/yaxshi/
  qiziqarli ekanini ko'rsatish uchun ishlatamiz.


KITOBNING UCh MISOLI VA IZOHI:

  It is QUITE dark.
     ( = It is A BIT dark. )
     = Ancha qorong'i. (biroz qorong'i)

  It is VERY dark.
     ( = It is EXTREMELY dark. )
     = Juda qorong'i. (o'ta qorong'i)

  It is TOO dark.
     ( = It is SO dark THAT I CAN'T SEE. )
     = Haddan tashqari qorong'i.
       (shunchalik qorong'iki, ko'ra olmayman)


ENG MUHIM FARQ — DARAJA CHIZIG'I:

     quite  <  very  <  too
      (+)       (++)     (−)
     biroz     juda    haddan
                       tashqari

  DIQQAT: 'too' shunchaki 'very' dan kuchliroq
  EMAS. 'too' butunlay BOShQA narsani aytadi —
  u MUAMMO borligini bildiradi.

     'very dark'  → qorong'i, lekin muammo yo'q
     'too dark'   → shunchalik qorong'iki,
                    biror ishni QILA OLMAYMAN

  Kitob buni izohda ANIQ ko'rsatgan:
     'It is SO dark THAT I CAN'T SEE.'
     ('can't' — imkonsizlik)


Coursebook 86-BET BILAN BOG'LIQ:
  U yerda AYNAN shu qoida mehmonxona narxlari
  bilan ko'rsatilgan edi:
     £95 → 'VERY expensive'  (qimmat, lekin
                              £100 ichida)
     £120 → 'TOO expensive'  (£100 dan OShADI —
                              SOTIB OLA OLMAYDI)
  Va kalit qutisida:
     quite noisy (+), very noisy (++),
     much noisier (+++), too noisy (−)


QOIDA — QAYSI SHAKL BILAN KELADI:

  quite + ODDIY sifat    →  quite dark
  very  + ODDIY sifat    →  very dark
  too   + ODDIY sifat    →  too dark
  much  + QIYOSIY daraja →  much darker

  DIQQAT: 'much' bu uchtadan FARQ QILADI —
  u faqat QIYOSIY daraja bilan ishlatiladi.


QO'ShIMChA MISOLLAR:
  It's quite cold.  = Ancha sovuq.
  It's very cold.   = Juda sovuq.
  It's too cold.    = Haddan tashqari sovuq
                      (tashqariga chiqib bo'lmaydi).

  The film was quite good.  = Film ancha yaxshi edi.
  The film was very good.   = Film juda yaxshi edi.
  The tea is too hot.       = Choy haddan tashqari
                              issiq (ichib bo'lmaydi).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a bit      = biroz
  extremely  = o'ta darajada
  dark       = qorong'i
  so ... that = shunchalik ... ki

points.en: We use words like very, quite or too, to show how cold/good/interesting, etc something or someone is.
points.uz: 'very', 'quite' yoki 'too' kabi so'zlarni biror narsa yoki odam qanchalik sovuq/yaxshi/qiziqarli ekanini ko'rsatish uchun ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz: Uchalasi ham sifatning DARAJASINI ko'rsatadi.

points.en: It is quite dark. (= It is a bit dark.)
points.noteUz:
ENG ZAIF daraja.
'a bit' = biroz.

points.en: It is very dark. (= It is extremely dark.)
points.noteUz:
'quite' dan KUCHLIROQ.
'extremely' = o'ta darajada.
Lekin MUAMMO borligini bildirmaydi.

points.en: It is too dark. (= It is so dark that I can't see.)
points.uz: Haddan tashqari qorong'i. (= Shunchalik qorong'iki, ko'ra olmayman.)
points.noteUz:
SALBIY — MUAMMO bor.
Kitobning izohidagi 'I CAN'T see' —
imkonsizlikni ko'rsatadi.
'too' 'very' dan shu bilan farq qiladi.

wordFormation.introUz: Grammar 52-bet — qiyosiy va orttirma daraja yasalishining to'liq qoidalari.

groups.ruleUz: QOIDA 2 — UNDOSH + URG'ULI UNLI + UNDOSH: undosh IKKILANADI

groups.explanationUz: '-y' TUSHADI. '-y' dan oldin UNDOSH bo'lishi shart.

groups.ruleUz: QOIDA 4 — IKKI+ BO'G'IN (-y siz): MORE / THE MOST

items.derived: the most luxurious OF the three
the tallest building IN the USA

groups.ruleUz: QUITE / VERY / TOO / MUCH — QAYSI ShAKL BILAN

items.derivedUz: = so dark that I can't see

patterns.exampleEn: The city is noisier than the country.
patterns.explanationUz:
QIYOSIY daraja — IKKI narsani solishtiradi.
Odatda 'THAN' bilan.

patterns.formula: A is THE [sifat]-EST / THE MOST [sifat] + OF [guruh] / IN [joy].
patterns.exampleEn: The giraffe is the tallest animal of all.
patterns.explanationUz:
ORTTIRMA daraja — bitta narsani BUTUN GURUH
bilan solishtiradi.
DOIM 'THE' bilan; OF + guruh, IN + joy.

patterns.formula: A is (NOT) AS [ODDIY sifat] AS B.
patterns.exampleEn: My brother is as tall as my father.
patterns.explanationUz:
TENGLIK qolipi.
'as' va 'as' orasiga sifatning ODDIY shakli
('as taller as' XATO).
Inkor shakli KAMROQ ekanini bildiradi.

patterns.formula: A is MUCH + [QIYOSIY daraja] THAN B.
patterns.exampleEn: An elephant is much heavier than a mouse.
patterns.explanationUz:
'much' farqni KUCHAYTIRADI.
Faqat QIYOSIY daraja bilan.

patterns.formula: It is QUITE / VERY / TOO + [ODDIY sifat].
patterns.exampleEn: It is quite dark. It is very dark. It is too dark.
patterns.exampleUz: Ancha qorong'i. Juda qorong'i. Haddan tashqari qorong'i.
patterns.explanationUz:
quite (biroz) < very (juda).
'too' esa MUAMMO borligini bildiradi:
'so ... that I can't ...'.
